paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea. 2 Chronicles 27:6 says, "So Jotham grew powerful because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God." The text gives the reason right there. His power came from how he lived before God, and the building and the winning came after that.

Now look at the other side, because the passage doesn't hide it. Jotham did what was right, and the text says "the people still behaved corruptly" (2 Chronicles 27:2). I think that stings a little. One person walking right with God matters a LOT, but it doesn't force everybody around him to follow.

So here's what it means for you, baker. Order your ways before the LORD, and do it even when nobody else in the kitchen is doing it. Jotham didn't wait for a crowd to join him, and neither do you. Keep your ways right before God, friend, and let Him handle the rest of the recipe.
